svg.title: JR Nagoya Station Ground Floor — Toilets, Coin Lockers and Transfers
svg.desc: North-up schematic with Taikodori Exit to the west and Sakuradori Exit to the east. All ten toilet locations have wheelchair-accessible toilets. Pink WC symbols indicate inside ticket gates; purple WC symbols indicate outside ticket gates. The JR Central local-line and Kintetsu-side toilets are outside gates. Includes outside toilet 1 beside the basement elevator, toilet 2 in Umaimon Street, toilet 3 near the city bus terminal, toilet 4 at the north-side concourse, and toilets inside JR Central Passage and Aonami gates. Nine coin-locker areas L1 to L9, vertical access and transfer directions are retained. Platform and basement floor plans are omitted.

g.text: All toilets shown have wheelchair-accessible facilities.
1F only. Pink toilets: inside gates. Purple toilets: outside gates. Locker markers indicate areas; adjacent facilities are schematic.
